verses.en: In the name of Allah, the Gracious, the Merciful.

verses.ar: اَلَمۡ تَرَ کَیۡفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّکَ بِاَصۡحٰبِ الۡفِیۡلِ ؕ﴿۲﴾
verses.en: Hast thou not seen how thy Lord dealt with the People of the Elephant?[✛]
Did He not cause their plan to miscarry?
And He sent against them swarms of birds,
Which ate their carrion, striking them against stones of clay.
And thus made them like broken straw, eaten up.
